dyk: The Quran's own grammar marks Yusuf as a name from outside Arabic.

born.text: Yosef, from the verb meaning “to add.” In Genesis his mother names him as a prayer for another son: he will add.

formed_verse.html: 12:7 reads fī Yūsufa. A native Arabic name in the same place ends in -in, as in fī Khālidin.

travelled.text: Persian poets made Yusuf the emblem of beauty; Jami's Yusuf and Zulaikha (1483) is the best known retelling. The name spread with Muslim communities from Morocco to Indonesia, changing its spelling at every border.

edge: Keeping warmth and steadiness in balance. Under pressure one tends to swallow the other.
dua: May every Yusuf be given patience in trial, beauty in character, and the strength to forgive.
rail_intro: From the prophet to today, grouped by what they are remembered for.

groups.label: The first Yusuf
people: Prophet Yusuf, peace be upon him
Son of Prophet Yaqub. His whole life is told in one surah.

groups.label: Rulers and builders
people: Sultan of Egypt and Syria, known in the West as Saladin. Retook Jerusalem in 1187.
Almoravid ruler who united Morocco and al-Andalus.
Nasrid sultan who built the Alhambra's Gate of Justice and Comares Tower.

groups.label: Scholars and poets
people: Wrote Kutadgu Bilig (1069-70), a founding work of Turkic literature.

groups.label: In our time
people: Singer-songwriter, formerly known as Cat Stevens.
Pakistan batter. Most Test runs in a calendar year: 1,788 in 2006.
Turkish sport shooter. Olympic silver medallist, Paris 2024.
